description: This file defines the data structures, loading functions, and prediction logic for 'Model A' in the project. It includes classes for model metadata and artifacts, functions to load ONNX models and scalers, mock model creation for testing, feature matrix building, and the prediction functions for both ONNX and mock models.

classes.name: ModelAMeta
classes.description: Dataclass holding metadata for Model A, including sequence length, features, flood threshold, and optional ONNX input name.

classes.name: ModelAArtifacts
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating the model provider type, metadata, scalers, and ONNX model instance.

methods.name: ModelAArtifacts load_model_a_onnx( onnx_path: str, meta_path: str, scaler_x_path: str, scaler_y_path: str, )
methods.description: Loads the ONNX model, scalers, and associated metadata to produce ModelAArtifacts for predictions.

methods.name: ModelAArtifacts create_mock_model_a(*, seq_len: int, flood_threshold_mm: float, baseline_mm: float = 200.0)
methods.description: Creates a deterministic mock model artifact for development and testing, with fixed behavior based on input parameters.

methods.name: tuple[float,float] month_to_cyc(month: int)
methods.description: Converts a month integer into sine and cosine cycle features for seasonal encoding.

methods.name: np.ndarray build_feature_matrix(sequence: list[dict[str, float]], feature_names: list[str])
methods.description: Constructs a feature matrix from a sequence of climate data dicts and feature names, including seasonal features.

methods.name: dict[str,float] _predict_next_rainfall_mm_mock(art: ModelAArtifacts, sequence: list[dict[str, float]], baseline_mm: float)
methods.description: Deterministic mock predictor generating plausible rainfall and flood probability based on input sequence.

methods.name: dict[str,float] predict_next_rainfall_mm(art: ModelAArtifacts, sequence: list[dict[str, float]], *, mock_baseline_mm: float = 200.0)
methods.description: Predicts next-month rainfall in mm and flood probability using either ONNX model or mock model, depending on provider.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] model_a_meta_as_dict(meta: ModelAMeta)
methods.description: Serializes Model A metadata to a dictionary for diagnostics or external use.
